# API reference

Every `class_name` the addon defines. The summary is the first line of the
class's own documentation comment; the full text is in the source file, and
in Godot's built-in help once the addon is enabled.

Scripts with no `class_name` are omitted deliberately. Autoloads have none
(a global class would collide with the singleton), modules have none (they are
instantiated by the catalog, not referenced globally), and events have none
(they are matched by name on the bus).
